devanagari.text: जो इछै सो फलु पाइसी पुतु धनु लखमी खड़ि मेले हरि निसतारे ॥

english.default: All treasures are in the True Guru, who has enshrined the Lord within the heart.

translation.spanish: El Verdadero Guru tiene todos los Tesoros con Él, porque guarda al Señor siempre en su mente.

english.default: He alone obtains the Perfect True Guru, on whose forehead such blessed destiny is pre-ordained.
